# Closure-ratio corpus. One URL per line; blank lines and # comments ignored.
#
# `# expect: close`   — a reading page. Held open = the auto-close thesis failing.
# `# expect: suspend` — a tool, form or app. Closed = DATA LOSS. This is the gate.
# A marker applies to every URL beneath it until the next marker.
#
# The ratio alone is a metric that cannot detect data loss: it is maximized by
# deleting rule 1. The `expect: suspend` block is the counter-weight. Never
# "fix" a leak by moving a URL out of it.

# expect: close
